name: graphql-mutation-under-a-read-use
why: Control: a GraphQL mutation that closes an issue, under a read-only use, its query shown.

body.content: {"query":"mutation CloseIssue($id: ID!) { closeIssue(input: {issueId: $id}) { issue { number state } } }","variables":{"id":"I_kwDOabc43"}}

statements: allow read on issue "43" in repository "discobox-ai/discobox"
allow read on issue comment within issue "43" in repository "discobox-ai/discobox"

definitions.issue comment: A comment on a GitHub issue.
